sections.heading: Why visit Langkawi
paragraphs: Langkawi (Southeast Asia) is known for its beach, island and nature experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to April.
